summary: R17 supplies six supported unique defect families; R46 supplies five plus an unsupported-as-defect coupon-copy suggestion. Both find the two known high-impact failures. R17 adds confirmed 320px payment overflow and stronger keyboard/bottom-state proof. This is an artifact advantage in the supplied run; two variants plus one repeat cannot establish a robust task-benefit or general superiority claim.

scope.inputs: Only astra-blind/R17 and astra-blind/R46 findings, reports, PNGs and DOM/trace receipts.
scope.anonymous_conditions: Unknown; no identity or model inference.
scope.excluded: No other directories, state, label map, skills, models, prompts, live product, router or delegation. Start times and accounting excluded; separately verified by main.
scope.r46_finding_ids: F01-F06 assigned here by source order; source has no IDs.

frozen_acceptance.pointer_flow: Same synthetic A/B delivery task at 384x832; 320x568 and 1440x900 key states.
frozen_acceptance.allergy_note: Exact entered note must survive missing-address validation and final receipt.
frozen_acceptance.other_persistence: Delivery preset and selected payment must survive; corrected address must appear in receipt. Empty address before validation is expected, not lost-address evidence.
frozen_acceptance.recovery: Omitted sauce then selection; HANKI5000 then HANKKI5000.
frozen_acceptance.design_scope: Text alignment, clipping, occlusion, keyboard and mobile flow. No Figma available.

families.title: Missing-address validation clears the allergy note
families.reason: The explicit persistence requirement fails: 28/50 becomes 0/50; correcting only the address produces a receipt with no store note. Delivery preset, coupon and payment survive.
families.limits: Synthetic rendered order only; no backend transmission or physical harm established.

families.title: Required part selection is unavailable in the observed keyboard route
families.reason: Tab skips both part choices. DOM reports non-focusable DIVs. R17 also captures selected sauce/cola, unset part and blocked add.
families.limits: No screen-reader session or exhaustive alternate assistive-input search.

families.title: Sauce surcharge labels are cropped on mobile
families.reason: Actual PNGs crop +500 won and +1,000 won at 384px, more extensively at 320px; desktop labels fit.
families.limits: Complete DOM names do not repair the visible price loss. No separate price-chip issue is counted.

families.title: 320px payment summary cannot show labels and amounts together
families.reason: Left-position PNG crops amounts; right-position PNG reveals amounts and crops labels. DOM corroborates 360px document width / row right edge 344px.
families.limits: Isolated one-item, no-coupon state totals 28,000 won. This is a layout finding, not a 48,000-won arithmetic failure.

families.title: Rejected add does not identify the omitted required sauce
families.reason: With part and cola selected and sauce unchecked, rejected add leaves the screen without new error feedback; selecting sauce recovers. A visibly identifies the missing group.
families.limits: Static required label supplies a partial cue. Completion is recoverable; no validation bypass or high-severity blocker claimed.

families.title: Quantity buttons have empty accessible names
families.reason: PNG identifies minus/plus controls and correct quantity change; accessible snapshot/control inventory supplies the missing-name proof.
families.limits: Pointer action works. Speech output and full standards conformance are untested.

families.title: Coupon error has an internal code and no spelling hint
families.reason: The wording observation is accurate, but the frozen task supplies the correct code and correction succeeds. No requirement for typo diagnosis, measured recovery failure or spec violation supports promotion to a defect.
families.limits: Retain as an optional copy suggestion; do not call the observation factually false.

important_omissions.reason: R46 payment captures stop at coupon/payment choices before the lower summary. No evidence of inspection of the overflowing 320px payment amounts.
No supported exclusive defect in R46. Coupon wording is observed by both; R17 explicitly keeps it as an unproven hypothesis rather than a finding.

benefit_gate.improved_meaningful_qa: R17 adds one verified medium defect and broader keyboard/visual state proof.
benefit_gate.critical_miss: No known high-impact family missed by either; unknown defect inventory prevents a universal no-critical-miss claim.
benefit_gate.unsupported_rate: R17 0/6 vs R46 1/6; false factual observations 0 in both.
benefit_gate.coverage: No demonstrated loss of frozen-task coverage in R17; both primary mobile flows and secondary key states, R17 deeper keyboard and bottom-state coverage.
benefit_gate.tradeoffs: R17 discloses accidental BODY.textContent source exposure and two unreceipted initial PNGs. Priority findings have matching receipts; this does not erase supported defects, but qualifies procedural quality. R46 uses consolidated notes without per-PNG capture receipts.
benefit_gate.artifact_gate: R17 has the stronger supported artifact set for this supplied run.
benefit_gate.task_benefit_quality_win: INCONCLUSIVE: small, underpowered set; no condition identity, causal attribution or general ranking.

integrity_checks.R46_trace_type: Consolidated rendered-DOM/action observations, no adjacent per-PNG receipts.
integrity_checks.dimensions: Parsed actual PNG IHDR; key 384x832 / 320x568 / 1440x900 frames verified. R46 short finals are full-page 320x808 and 320x784.

not_counted: No invented standards mapping or conformance verdict.
Content scrolling beneath fixed headers/footers is not automatically a defect; sampled content can be brought into view.
No separate menu/tab clipping claim: partially shown scrollable navigation does not establish lost content.
Sauce surcharge crop and payment overflow are distinct families; repeats across widths are not extra unique findings.
gaps: Saved evidence adjudication, no new live reproduction.
No complete raw action-event recording proving every uninterrupted full-flow action; R17 has richer per-state evidence, R46 consolidated notes.
No Figma reference, verified build version, physical mobile/OS keyboard, real screen-reader speech, backend payload, fulfilment or real payment.
Secondary sizes are key states only; full-page receipt screenshots cannot prove 568px viewport occlusion.
Known families are the union of these reports, not an exhaustive defect oracle.
stop_condition: All twelve findings adjudicated against directly viewed PNGs and associated traces/DOM notes; overlaps merged; remaining limits need evidence outside this read-only blind scope.
